title: Cirrhy document
description: The single JSON file (cirrhy.json) holding all of a Cirrhy user's tracking data. Produced and consumed by packages/cirrhy_merge; the schema-sync test in that package keeps this file in step with the code. Importers: read doc/llms.md alongside this schema — it carries the rules a valid-but-wrong document would break.

formatVersion.description: Writers stamp the version they produce; readers accept this version and older, and refuse newer ones rather than write a lossy file back. v2 added importSource/externalId.

runningTimers.description: One per device with a live timer, keyed by deviceId. Importers must never create these.

tombstones.description: Recorded deletions. Without its tombstone, a deleted record is resurrected by the next merge with any copy that still holds it.

timestamp.description: UTC instant, ISO 8601 with trailing Z, e.g. 2026-08-14T09:30:00.000Z.

uuid.description: RFC 4122 v4, freshly minted for every record. Never derived from or reused as a source system's identifier — that is what externalId is for.

importSource.description: Which import produced this record; absent on everything made by hand. A free string naming the migration (e.g. 'kimai - truenas'), identical on every record of one import batch. Traceability only, never a merge key; rollback of a batch is 'tombstone every record whose importSource matches'.

externalId.description: The record's identifier in its source system; absent on everything made by hand. Compound (importer's choice of encoding) when the source needs more than one value to name a record.

history.description: Prior versions of this record, demoted by merges it lost; newest first. Importers omit this — imported records have no past.

locationChanged.description: When this project was last re-parented to another client. Moves merge independently of edits; a new record sets this equal to modified.

clientId.description: The owning client's id, or null for a project with no client. Must resolve within this document.

color.description: Hex color like #RRGGBB, or null for the default.

projectId.description: The owning project's id, or null. Must resolve within this document.

stop.description: null means the entry is still open (a live timer from another device). start and stop are one unit: they are written together and merged together, never mixed across versions. Importers always write a non-null stop.

taskId.description: If set, must belong to the project named by projectId.

id.description: Equal to deviceId — the running timer is keyed by device, one per device.
The id of the deleted record, in whichever collection it lived.
